data.description: Experience the ultimate **Speed Boat Adventure Tour** in **San Diego Bay**! This **fully narrated 13-mile tour** takes you on an unforgettable journey across the iconic **Big Bay**, offering stunning views of San Diego's top attractions. Feel the thrill as you speed past **Navy ships**, the historic **USS Midway Aircraft Museum**, and the majestic **Coronado Bridge**. Explore the beauty of the **Star of India** and the historic ships of the **Maritime Museum**, while also catching a glimpse of the bustling **Cruise Ship Terminal** and the charming **Seaport Village**. Don't forget to admire the striking **San Diego downtown skyline** and spot the incredible wildlife that thrives in **San Diego Harbor**. Book your **San Diego speed boat tour** today and embark on a one-of-a-kind adventure!
data.highlights:
#### **Tour Highlights**
1. **USS Midway Aircraft Museum**  
   - Glide past this impressive naval museum, taking in its massive size and historical significance.

2. **Navy Ships**  
   - Experience a close-up view of active Navy ships stationed in the bay, showcasing the strength of the U.S. Navy.

3. **Coronado Bridge**  
   - Zoom under the breathtaking Coronado Bridge, a marvel of architecture connecting San Diego to Coronado Island.

4. **Star of India & Maritime Museum**  
   - Admire the historic Star of India, the world’s oldest active sailing ship, along with other historic vessels at the Maritime Museum.

5. **San Diego Cruise Ship Terminal**  
   - Cruise by the bustling terminal where luxury liners dock and passengers from around the world arrive.

6. **Seaport Village**  
   - Enjoy a scenic view of this quaint waterfront shopping and dining area from the water.

7. **Downtown San Diego Skyline**  
   - Take in panoramic views of San Diego's iconic skyline, a perfect backdrop for photos.

8. **San Diego Harbor Wildlife**  
   - Watch for playful sea lions, pelicans, and other native wildlife that call the harbor home.
data.itinerary:
### **Speed Boat Adventure Tour of San Diego Bay Itinerary**

#### **Duration**: Approximately 1.5 - 2 hours

---

#### **Check-in & Safety Briefing**
- **Arrival Time**: 30 minutes prior to departure
- Meet at the designated dock for check-in.
- Receive a safety briefing on how to operate the speed boat and essential boating rules.
- Get fitted with life jackets and other necessary safety gear.

---

#### **Departure** 
- **Starting Point**: San Diego Bay (Exact location provided during booking).
- After a quick orientation, embark on your 13-mile adventure around the stunning San Diego Bay.
- Follow the guide as you begin to navigate your own speed boat.


#### **Return & Docking**
- Complete the thrilling loop around San Diego Bay and return to the starting dock.
- Turn in your life jackets and gear.
- **End of tour**: A quick recap and goodbye from your guide, with time for questions or final photos.



**Note**: Time on the water and tour duration may vary based on weather conditions and boat speed.

Activity may be canceled at tour guide's discretion due to weather conditions including heavy rain, high winds, or lightning. As safety is our top priority, weather cancellations are made on a cruise by cruise basis up to time of departure. In the rare situation the seller must cancel the event prior to departure, ticket-holders will be allowed to reschedule tickets (subject to availability), receive a gift card, or receive a full refund (including trip protection).

If an activity is cut short early due to severe weather, rainchecks will be given to all guests. Full refunds are not available after the cruise leaves the dock, but rainchecks do not expire.

Refund and Rescheduling Policy
All sales are final, unless trip protection is purchased up front. No refunds, reissue to gift cards, or rescheduling will be permitted without trip protection.

Trip Protection Policy
Trip Protection must be added at the time of purchase. Trip Protection allows for rescheduling (subject to availability) or refund of tickets up to 120 minutes prior to departure time, for any reason. Tickets purchased within 120 minutes of cruise departure will be a final sale, and non-refundable. Refunds will reimburse for the full amount of each ticket, less the Trip Protection fees.

Trip Protection is voided and no refunds will be issued if (1) guest(s) arrive and check into the cruise, (2) guest(s) do not cancel at least 120 minutes prior to the departure time, or (3) guest(s) no show without notification.

data.check_in_details:
### **Check-In Instructions for Speed Boat Adventures in San Diego**

Welcome to **Speed Boat Adventures San Diego**! Please follow these check-in instructions to ensure a smooth and timely start to your adventure:

---

#### **1. Arrival Time**
- Please arrive **30 minutes prior** to your scheduled departure time. This allows enough time for check-in, safety briefing, and boat orientation.
  
#### **2. Check-In Location**
- **Address**: Cabrillo Isle Marina | 1450 Harbor Island Drive, San Diego, CA 92101
- Once you arrive, head to the designated **Speed Boat Adventures check-in booth** or office, which will be clearly marked.

#### **3. Parking**
- On-site parking is available. Please allow extra time to park as spaces may be limited depending on the time of day and season.
- Alternatively, there are public parking lots nearby, as well as street parking. Some lots may require a fee.

#### **4. Required Documents**
- Bring a **valid photo ID** (driver's license or passport) for each participant.
- If you booked online, have your **booking confirmation number** or email ready for faster check-in.

#### **5. Waiver Forms**
- All participants must sign a **liability waiver** before the tour begins. Waivers can be completed:
  - **Online** before your arrival (recommended for quicker check-in).
  - **On-site** at the check-in booth.
  
#### **6. Safety Briefing**
- Upon check-in, you'll participate in a **mandatory safety briefing**. This includes:
  - Instructions on how to operate the speed boat.
  - Important safety rules and guidelines for boating in San Diego Bay.
  - Fitting for life jackets (provided by us) and other safety gear.



We can't wait to see you for your **Speed Boat Adventure**! If you have any questions before your arrival, feel free to contact us

data.faqs:
### **Restrictions and Requirements for Speed Boat Adventures**

#### **Age/Children**:
- **Recommended Age**: We recommend that children riding with adults be at least **5 years old**.
- **Children Under 5**: Allowed on a **case-by-case basis**. Conditions for participation include:
  - The water conditions must be calm.
  - The child must be physically capable of holding on during the ride.
  - If water conditions are rough, children under 5 are **not permitted** for safety reasons.

#### **Age/Driver**:
- To drive the boat **alone**, the age requirements vary by location:
  - **San Diego**: Drivers must be **18 years old**.
 

#### **Height/Weight**:
- **Height**: There are **no height restrictions** for participating in the tour.
- **Weight Limit**: The total combined weight per boat must not exceed **450 lbs**.

Feel free to contact us if you have further questions or specific needs regarding age or weight restrictions!

### **Health Restrictions for Speed Boat Adventures**

At **Speed Boat Adventures**, the experience includes riding in **open water**, which can sometimes be choppy, though it is typically calm. Due to the nature of the ride, there are certain health restrictions to ensure the safety and comfort of our guests:

- **Neck or Back Problems**: Guests with pre-existing **neck or back issues** are advised not to participate, as the boat's movements in choppy water may aggravate these conditions.
  
- **Recent Surgery**: If you have had **recent surgery**, it is not recommended to join the tour, as the physical demands and sudden movements could impact your recovery.
  
- **Pregnant Women**: For safety reasons, **pregnant women** should **not participate** in the tour.

We prioritize your well-being and encourage you to consult with a healthcare professional if you have any concerns regarding your health and the activity.

### **Can We Switch Drivers?**

**Absolutely!** During our **Charleston Harbor** and **San Diego Harbor** boat tours, there are several stops along the way. This allows you the opportunity to **switch drivers** halfway through the tour if you’d like. So, feel free to share the experience and take turns behind the wheel!

### **What If I Have Never Driven a Boat?**

No worries at all! Our boats are designed to be **very easy to operate**, even for beginners. Before the tour begins, we provide a thorough orientation and ensure you feel **completely comfortable** with operating the boat. Our guides will be there to help and answer any questions, so you’ll be ready to enjoy the adventure with confidence!
